title: AC1024 DWG associative capture and graph-audit implementation
mode: P4 adapter retention and fail-closed output slice
scope: Retain DWG associative callbacks in a separate bounded store and generation-scoped receipt, without mixing them into the DXF raw/typed receipt.
Audit the selected AC1024 body → dependency → constraint-group → network edges from explicit handles and ownership/action fields.
Keep strict-complete DWG-to-DXF export refused when associative objects are present because a complete writer route is not implemented.

implementation.summary: Added a DWG-only associative vector and import receipt, bounded callback accounting, an AC1024 selected-edge audit, and strict-complete preflight refusal while the associative writer is absent.
behaviorChanges: DWG associative typed callbacks are retained separately from DXF associative records and raw-carrier receipt state.

The AC1024 audit counts explicit body→dependency, dependency→constraint-group, and reciprocal owned group→network action edges; it does not certify other associative descendants or a root dictionary path.
Strict-complete DXF export refuses whenever DWG associative objects or capture failures are present; no DXF records are emitted for these objects.

results.strictTargetBuild: PASS with configured -Werror flags. Two initial compile errors (gate declaration order and unused renamed constant) were corrected before the passing build.
results.runtimeGraphAudit: PASS for the selected 17 AC1024 body/dependency/group/network paths; each edge count equals the 17 body count and the adapter reports a complete selected-edge audit.
results.strictCli: EXPECTED_REFUSAL after the graph audit because no complete associative DXF writer route exists.

limitations: The bounded receipt and edge-audit code still needs runtime confirmation against a source-matched AC1024 import.
The audit covers only selected body/dependency/group/network edges; it does not prove network-root reachability, full associative descendant closure, or all target roles.
No associative DXF serializer, identity remapping, emitted-field proof, or consumer qualification is implemented.
The local source sample is not committed; no support claim is promoted.
